title: Quantifying Normality: Convergence Rate to Gaussian Limit for Stochastic Approximation and Unadjusted OU Algorithm
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical investigation into the convergence properties of stochastic approximation algorithms using tools from stochastic calculus and Stein's method. It contains no discussion or evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics.
